plan: Keep queueing carry as primary — it is already Goldilocks324's usual queue AND best role at 52.0% over 214 games (overall is 52.1%).
Goldilocks324's champion pool is 8+ heroes wide and the top three are only 31% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Goldilocks324 is at 730 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 922 — Platinum-level rating has been touched once already; this is a consistency problem, not a ceiling problem.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Goldilocks324 is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 82%. Past 32: 50%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 14 of 17 short games vs 9 of 18 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: Goldilocks324 is running hotter than the career line

insights.title: The tilt tax is real for Goldilocks324
insights.finding: Right after a loss Goldilocks324 wins 50%; right after a win, 69%. One cooldown break after losses is free VP.
insights.receipt: 10/20 after losses vs 20/29 after wins, last 50 games

insights.title: Cuban brings out Goldilocks324's best
insights.finding: Goldilocks324's record alongside Cuban Noobster is 56% over 268 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.
